target.statement: Gini KNN (ν*) achieves the highest average rank (3.12) in precision across 16 UCI datasets, compared to 11 other distance-based KNN models.
target.dataset: 16 UCI datasets (Iris, Wine, Breast-Cancer, Sonar, QSAR, Vehicle, Australian, Glass, Ionosphere, Banknote, German, Heart, Balance, Haberman, Wholesale, Indian Liver)

compute.basis: 16 small UCI datasets, KNN with k=1..11 and ν grid search, 3-fold CV; CPU-only, but requires implementing Gini prametric and conditional ranks, and verifying code completeness.

blockers: Code repository may be incomplete or outdated; need to verify it reproduces the exact ranking.
Conditional rank computation for test points is non-trivial and must be implemented correctly.
No GPU needed, but careful implementation and debugging may take time.
title: KNN and K-means in Gini Prametric Spaces
